name: WdOLEVerb
description: Specifies the action associated with the verb that the OLE object should perform.

constants.name: wdOLEVerbPrimary
constants.description: Performs the verb that is invoked when the user double-clicks the object.

constants.name: wdOLEVerbShow
constants.description: Shows the object to the user for editing or viewing. Use it to show a newly inserted object for initial editing.

constants.name: wdOLEVerbOpen
constants.description: Opens the object in a separate window.

constants.name: wdOLEVerbHide
constants.description: Removes the object's user interface from view.

constants.name: wdOLEVerbUIActivate
constants.description: Activates the object in place and displays any user-interface tools that the object needs, such as menus or toolbars.

constants.name: wdOLEVerbInPlaceActivate
constants.description: Runs the object and installs its window, but doesn't install any user-interface tools.

constants.name: wdOLEVerbDiscardUndoState
constants.description: Forces the object to discard any undo state that it might be maintaining; note that the object remains active, however.
